page.overview:
What is Bad Romance?

Bad Romance (バッド・ロマンス Baddo romansu) is the Stand given to Fujiko Fujiyama by Whitesnake, featured in Fujiko's Bizarre Worldly Wisdom.

Bad Romance is a human feminine Stand. It has a headpiece similar to that of Whitesnake, with feathers or hair at the top. It has jewels in the shape of hearts in place of eyes. It also appears to be wearing a brassiere.

Fujiko Fujiyama is an inmate in Green Dolphin Street. An artist, she started selling her drawings for money. At some point, she encountered Whitesnake, which gave her the DISC that contained Bad Romance. People who bought art that Fujiko drew after that point kept coming back to her, seemingly too aroused to take it. After afflicting Jolyne Cujoh with the effects of the Stand, Pucci found Fujiko drawing religious art of Jolyne, to which Pucci took offense and was afraid that it would empower Jolyne, causing him to take back the Stand's DISC.

Whenever anyone takes art from Fujiko, their emotions come under her control. When Fujiko draws a picture of a person who has accepted art from her, that person then begins to feel the way that the picture drawn of them represents, as evidenced by how drawing erotic pictures of Jolyne made her start to feel incredibly aroused, while drawing her in the style of a religious figure made her begin to become enlightened and able to do various yoga poses with great ease.
